name: Quantile Interpolation of Nonparametric Distributions in 3D
definition: An extension of 1D quantile interpolation to 3D grid cells using bilinear interpolation logic, computing the interpolated PDF at an interior point by sequentially interpolating along edges, then faces, then the volume.
summary: Quantile Interpolation of Nonparametric Distributions in 3D computes interpolated probability density functions at arbitrary 3D positions by sequentially applying 1D quantile interpolation along edges, faces, and volumes.
